q1_issues.issue: "the first snow **of Year 2**" drops the ordinal's stated restricting domain — `(Ordinal sk_snow_1 1 fall)` claims first-ever rather than first of that year (only partly recoverable from the fall event's own Year term).
"that week" is reduced to `(Time sk_count_1 (Year 2))`, so the anaphoric link to the day-470 week is not recorded; the conservative choice is right, but the week identity is lost.

q2_gaps: week-level temporal anchoring — the structured Time term vocabulary has Year / Month / Day / Weekday / Hour / Minute but no week term, so "that week" has no carrier under term propagation
a restricting domain on an `Ordinal` ("the first snow of Year 2") — the head has no slot for it and no entity-attached form is specified
notes: The rest is a close match to the instruction set: definite-projection out of the strength-0 denial, both reified-plus-flat copular dual-emits, precipitation and intransitive-subject roles, compound genus with an un-exposed noun modifier, and the name-with-kind-word handling of "Harbor Station". Treating `early_evening` as a decomposable compound kind rather than a bare day-part symbol is an extension, but a consistent one.
